messages:
Alice Chen: Hey team — syncing on the Secure Connectors launch with SecureHub next week. Need owners for SSO/SCIM, KMS integration verification, and marketplace artifacts. TL;DR: partner expects SSO + SCIM + bring-your-own-KMS demo + joint blog/press. Who can take what? :eyes:

Ben Ortiz: I can own KMS/HSM checklist and attestation items. Quick Q: do we need HSM-backed keywrap for their marketplace offer or is tenant-managed KMS ok?

Alice Chen: Partner prefers HSM for enterprise customers, but they said a BYOK path is acceptable for initial listing. We should document both flows.

Carla Gomez: Engineering timeline: we have a staging connector that supports SAML + SCIM provisioning. KMS hooks exist but need an extra CI matrix to test key wrapping. ETA for full e2e tests = 7 business days if nothing blocks.

Samir Patel: For marketplace listing we need: screenshots, short + long descriptions, a compliance checkbox (we declare BYOK/HSM support), pricing tier mapping, and a launch assets package for their marketplace team. I'll draft the assets.

Lily Zhou: Legal note: embargo window is strict — partner wants a coordinated announcement at 10am PT on 2026-04-09. Marketing + Legal need final sign-off 72h prior. Also confirm no customer names in the joint blog without explicit consent.

Matt Ko: Ops: I'll prep a terraform module snippet for the BYOK flow and a sample KMS KeyPolicy we can hand to partners. Also will stand up a temporary test HSM instance in our lab for their SI to run against.

Ben Ortiz: Putting my checklist here:
```
- KMS mode: BYOK (tenant) -> docs + sample policy
- KMS mode: HSM-backed -> attestation steps + certs
- CI tests for keywrap/unwrap (AES-GCM + RSA-OAEP)
- Threat model note -> review from sec-arch
- Rotation plan + zero-downtime rewrap
```
Will coordinate with sec-arch for review.

Carla Gomez: @Ben Ortiz if you add the CI matrix I'll add test targets. For SCIM we need a partner test org — @Alice Chen can you confirm partner will provide test tenant and sample users?

Alice Chen: Confirmed — SecureHub will provide a sandbox tenant and 2 service accounts. I'll paste contact: dev-ops@securehub.co.

partner-bot: securehub_webhook: new integration ticket created -> https://securehub.atlassian.net/browse/SH-429

Samir Patel: I'll assemble the marketplace package draft by EOD Friday. Can someone share approved boilerplate for security claims? Lily?

Lily Zhou: I'll send the approved security boilerplate and review the marketplace copy. Expect an email Monday with redlines.

Alice Chen: Next steps and owners: Ben = KMS/HSM verification + attestation docs; Carla = eng + CI tests; Samir = marketplace assets; Matt = infra snippets + test HSM; Lily = legal/embargo sign-off. I'll coordinate kickoff with SecureHub (intro call Wednesday 11am PT). If any blockers surface ping me. :thumbsup:
